item.title: DECLINE OF THE I Share Pro-Shot Live Video for ‘Diev Vide’
item.description: French philosophically-themed black metallers DECLINE OF THE I share pro-shot live video for the song “Diev Vide”, lifted from the band’s fourth studio album “Johannes” from 2021. item.title: BLOODRIDE Unveil New Video for ‘Kill without Hate’
item.description: Old-school thrash metal veterans Bloodride return with their new video for the song, “Kill Without Hate,” a relentless attack on the cold, emotionless face of modern warfare. The track portrays the grim reality of violence removed from human consequence, where killing becomes as impersonal and routine as a video game. Fast, brutal, and unflinching, “Kill Without Hate” is classic Bloodride: old-school thrash intensity […]

item.title: KALANDRA Share Beautiful Lyric Video for ‘Hymna til Blåfjell’ from New EP
item.description: The Norwegian collective KALANDRA unveils a captivating lyric video for “Hymna til Blåfjell” (Hymm to Blue Mountain). The song reimagines a deeply cherished hymn from the beloved Norwegian NRK Christmas TV series. Through Kalandra’s mesmerising Nordic charms, the track becomes both a nostalgic hymn and an atmospheric ode to the timeless spirit of Blåfjell. item.title: IMMORTALIS to Re-Issue Classic Album “Indicium De Mortuis” on 20th February
item.description: Death metal stalwarts Immortalis have announced the re-issue of their one and only album Indicium De Mortuis via Hammerheart Records. This dark, fluid and malevolent extreme metal masterpiece from 1991 will be released on vinyl and double CD on 20th February, 2026.
